paragraphs: Professor You served as Chief Physiotherapist for the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics and Paralympics. These photographs document his time at the Games with physiotherapy colleagues, medical teams and participants.
Professor You appeared on KTV’s Life & Policy programme with neurologist Na Hyun-wook to discuss stroke recognition and the importance of responding promptly.
KBS interviewed Professor You about robotic gait rehabilitation, including walking speed, movement control, muscle exercise and sensory feedback.
